ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black region at the central base extending toward the peduncle connection. Broad high-intensity white zones on both lobes with significant low-intensity mottling and stippling concentrated along the interior trailing edges and lower lateral regions. Distinct dark circular spots located in the upper-outer quadrants of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees; notch depth is approximately 18% of the visible vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude irregular serrations across the entire continuous trailing edge boundary. Specific deep jagged indentation visible on the mid-trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, transitioning to irregular, bulbous textures at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular dark pixel clusters (approximately 5-7 per lobe) distributed across the white ventral surface. Massive, three-dimensional textured pixel clusters corresponding to barnacle colonies are present on both lateral fluke tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the extreme lateral margins of both lobes, creating a significant departure from the smooth geometric edge of the fluke.
